location_fine: school office and an apartment room
character_types: bespectacled man in shirt and tie
visual_synopsis: A curly-haired bespectacled man in a grey shirt and tie sits at a desk in a pale-blue school office and delivers a long lecturing monologue to someone off camera. A schoolboy with a backpack then walks out through the corridor and stairwell into an apartment, where he finds the same man sprawled drunk on the floor beside a vodka bottle and a plate of tomato and lavash, and stands staring at him.
